items.title: LiveSearch: Questions as Executable Verifier Code for a Live Benchmark of Professional-Source Financial Search Agents
items.claim: Reused financial-search snapshots fail most questions within one day as gold values change daily.

items.title: How Much Does the Hint Matter? Scope Conditions for Hindsight Self-Distillation in Financial Reasoning
items.claim: Self-distillation gains come from supervision placement, not hint content or teacher size.

items.title: FinLLM-KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs for Financial Sentiment Analysis in Algorithmic Trading
items.claim: Knowledge-graph-augmented LLMs beat state-of-the-art financial sentiment baselines in portfolio simulations at near-zero cost.

items.title: Does Ecosystem Activity Validate TVL?
items.claim: Ecosystem-activity ratios do not make total value locked predict crypto returns after multiple-testing correction.

items.title: Event definition and the branching ratio: Hawkes estimates of price-change clustering in the consolidated quote feed
items.claim: The sub-millisecond Hawkes kernel in large-tick stocks reflects NBBO feed construction, not genuine price-change excitation.

items.title: FIDES-Live: Evaluating Behavioral Concordance in Sequential Trading Agents
items.claim: Commitment adherence drops to 62.63 percent for constrained nonempty proposals versus 97.56 percent for valid empty proposals.
